title: Case A: WhatsApp SEBI RA Impersonation + Personal VPA
description: Scammer claims to be 'Apex Capital' (a real SEBI Research Analyst), but uses a fake personal Google Pay UPI handle and promises 200% guaranteed jackpot return.
input_content: Namaste Sir! This is Apex Capital Research (SEBI Reg: INH000008921). Today's BankNifty Expiry special jackpot call! 200% GUARANTEED RETURN in 2 hours! 100% loss-free recovery formula. Registration fee ₹4,999 only. Hurry, only 5 slots left in our VIP group! Pay immediately to VPA: rajesh.advisory99@okhdfcbank to get immediate entry. WhatsApp confirmation to +919876543210.

expected_verdict.routing_reason: Claims real SEBI Research Analyst ID (INH000008921), but solicits unauthorized funds to personal savings VPA and violates SEBI PVA guaranteed return norms. Routed to SCORES 2.0 as Intermediary Impersonation/Misconduct.

title: Case B: Telegram Hindi Voice Note / Syndicate Scam
description: Unregistered Telegram channel operators promising daily fixed double money with no SEBI license, demanding cash pooling into a Paytm UPI address.
input_content: Arre bhai suno! Kal Nifty aur Sensex ka confirmed upper circuit setting ho chuka hai operator ke sath! 500% pakka guaranteed jackpot return milega! Jitna paisa lagana hai lagao, ek rupaye ka loss nahi hoga. Fee sirf ₹2,500 hai. Jaldi se paytm karo: sureprofit.pool@paytm par. Koi SEBI ki bakwaas hum nahi maante, seedha double paisa banate hain!

expected_verdict.routing_reason: Completely unregistered operator running illegal fund-pooling with explicit guaranteed return claims. Routed to National Cyber Crime Portal (1930) for VPA freeze and SEBI Market Intelligence for illegal collective schemes.

title: Case C: Cloned Trading Terminal APK & Phishing Domain
description: SMS link asking the user to install a fraudulent 'Zerodha Pro VIP' trading application from an unofficial lookalike domain.
input_content: Dear Zerodha User, your trading account will be suspended in 24 hours due to KYC mismatch. To avoid suspension and claim ₹10,000 Institutional Zero-Loss Margin, download our official updated application from: https://zer0dha-app.trade/login.apk and login with your PAN and password immediately.

expected_verdict.routing_reason: Distribution of malicious unauthorized APK terminal alongside typosquatted phishing domain (zer0dha-app.trade mimicking zerodha.com). Instant Critical Red-Line violation under IT Act Section 66D.

title: Case D: Legitimate SEBI Registered Broker (Safety Baseline)
description: Official communication from a verified SEBI-registered broker with statutory risk disclaimers, no guaranteed returns, and official corporate domain.
input_content: Notice from Zerodha Broking Limited (SEBI Reg No: INZ000031633). Securities market investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme related documents carefully before investing. For official account management, visit https://zerodha.com or write to support@zerodha.com. We never ask for client passwords or offer assured return schemes.

expected_verdict.routing_reason: Authentic SEBI Stock Broker registration (INZ000031633) matching official register. Legitimate domain, no return guarantees, mandatory risk disclosure present.
